$comment: Single source of truth for the 2026-05-10 canonical-agents handover kickoff.
Both kickoff.ts (SDK) and kickoff.sh (cursor-agent CLI) read this file.
SCHEMA NOTES (v2 — refactored 2026-05-10 after the tanastok deploy lesson):
- cwd: absolute path to the project workspace on this laptop
- sensitivity: 'normal' | 'health' | 'securities' | 'real-money' — gates safety constraints
- actions: ordered list of recommendations from the refreshed handover that THIS project owes
- emission_signals: code-presence checks (ripgrep / file existence). Honoured in --emission and --full
modes only. A hit means 'the code change is shipped to disk', NOT that production is running it.
- deploy_signals: live-production checks (curl URL, RPC call, dcscan.io stats). Honoured in --deploy
and --full modes only. A hit means 'production is verifiably running the new code'.
- already_done_signals (deprecated): pre-v2 alias. Treated as the union of emission+deploy when
emission_signals/deploy_signals aren't set.
- deploy_command: the audited shell command to deploy this project, harvested from
.cursor/quipu-canon-v1.2-deploy-plan.md. null = no scripted deploy path (deploy is human-owned).
- production_check: { url, expected_status, follow_redirects, ssh_state_check?, eas_check?,
rpc_check? } — used by primer STEP 5 (verify) and by --direct-deploy mode for end-to-end smoke
testing. eas_check is for Expo OTA deploys; rpc_check is for chain-level state.
- min_disk_gib: minimum free disk required to safely build+deploy this project. Pre-flight gate.
- ssh_keys_required: list of SSH key paths the deploy_command needs. Pre-flight gate.
- human_setup_required (optional, default false): true when the workspace needs one-off operator
config (linking an EAS project, creating a git remote, generating a service account) before the
deploy_command can run. Pre-flight surfaces this as a soft warning; --deploy mode skips deploy
step but still allows --emission to proceed.
- human_setup_checklist (optional): ordered list of one-off setup steps the operator must perform.
Surfaced verbatim by pre-flight when human_setup_required is true. Examples: link EAS project,
rotate API keys, configure git remote.
- primer_extra: a single concise project-specific paragraph
TANASTOK LESSON (2026-05-10): the v1 schema treated emission and deploy as one phase, so a
code-grep hit on emission_signals[0] was enough to write the 'implemented' marker even when the
deploy had crashed on ENOSPC and production was still serving the old build. The split below
makes that conflation impossible — STEP 0 in deploy mode now requires a deploy_signal hit (a live
URL serving HTTP 200 against the new build), not just a code-grep.
